notes.title: Beta Build 6/16/2017
notes.content:
Hi all, 

We have a new beta build up. Please check it out. 

These are the details. 

Mouse controls are fully optimized now. 
Issue with movement when equipping an axe has been fixed. 
Enemy drops will no longer go into the walls. 
Fix issue with scroll bars showing in incorrect spaces. 
Mouse over highlighting is now implemented. 
Fixed issue where characters could move over objects into/over walls. 
Fixed character editor button guides. 
Fixed character editor controls for the mouse. 
Fixed issue where spells could be cast consecutively. 
Fixed issue where when changing decimal damage setting the game would freeze. 

Thank you, dood.

Prinny Toshi

notes.title: Remaining issues those will be fixed! (Updated 6/12/2017)
notes.content:
Hello Cladun Users!

Thank you all for those who have showed an interest in this game. 
There are still some lingering minor issues those we are working on so we wanted to share the updated list with you today.
(We consider most of these issues are minor and shouldn't hinder normal game play too much.)
We will keep continuing to update the following issues when they are fixed!


[Gameplay]

Remaining Issues:
- There is an issue when killing enemies near a wall, their items will drop inside the wall.
- When playing online, monsters appear differently on each player's screen.
- Desynchronization occurs when fighting bosses online.
- Issue where players can move through moving walls.

Fixed Issues
- Attacking with the K key and right click no longer differ in damage.(6/12/2017)
- Fixed issues with the button guide showing the wrong buttons. (6/12/2017)
- Fixed issue when checking rankings for users with special characters in their names.(6/12/2017)


[Program]

Remaining Issues:
- Online Versus mode sometimes causes horizontal line artifacts.
- When the menu is shown on the "Drawing" page, and clicking the one of the menu showing in front of the coverage, the drawing coverage is colored. 

Fixed Issues
- Fixed issue with texture lines showing in battle stages.(6/12/2017)



[UI]

Remaining Issues:
- When switching between Full Screen to Windowed, the scroll bar will appear misaligned.
- Mousing over menu options will not highlight those options.
- Pixel editor button layout is slightly off-center.

Fixed Issues
- Key Config is now available for Keyboard + Mouse play. (6/12/2017)
- Character movement is now configurable. (6/12/2017)



Thanks! 
JUN_NISA

notes.title: Remaining issues those will be fixed! (Updated & Added 6/8/2017)
notes.content:
Hello Cladun Users!

Thank you for those who have showed an interest in this game. 
There are some lingering minor issues that we are still working on so we wanted to share these with you.
(We consider most of these issues minor and shouldn't hinder normal game play too much.)
We will continue to update the following issues when they are fixed!


[b][Gameplay][/b]

Remaining Issues:
- There is an issue when killing enemies near a wall, their items will drop inside the wall.
- When playing online, monsters appear differently on each player's screen.
- Desynchronization occurs when fighting bosses online.
- Issue where players can move through moving walls.

Fixed Issues:
- Axe charging animation does not display properly. (Fixed 6/8/2017)
- Right-clicking with a bow equipped results in an attack that does zero damage. (Partially fixed 6/8/2017)
- Game Control improvements using keyboards. (Added 6/8/2017)
- Investigating the title drop rate. (Added 6/8/2017)


[b][Program][/b]

Remaining Issues:
- Online Versus mode sometimes causes horizontal line artifacts.
- When the menu is shown on the "Drawing" page, and clicking the one of the menu showing in front of the coverage, the drawing coverage is colored. 

Fixed Issues:
- Issue where game freezes when playing on a laptop. (Fixed 6/6/2017)
- When players leave a lobby, their sprite graphic may remain in the lobby.(Fixed 6/8/2017)
- Saving an music editor file that contains no music will cause the game to freeze. (Fixed 6/6/2017)
- Edit Data not exporting correctly (Fixed 6/8/2017)


[b][UI][/b]

Remaining Issues:
- When switching between Full Screen to Windowed, the scroll bar will appear misaligned.
- Mousing over menu options will not highlight those options.
- Pixel editor button layout is slightly off-center.

Fixed Issues:
- Mouse Controls not working in some areas. (updated 6/6/2017)
- No error message appears when disconnected from online play. (Fixed 6/6/2017)
- No error message appears if the computer attempts to access online play without an Internet connection. (Fixed 6/8/2017)
- Playing online with keyboard controls will display Xbox button icons on screen. (Fixed 6/8/2017)
- When inputting names, sometimes the input window will remain on screen. (Fixed 6/6/2017)
- Displaying Xbox360 controllers without connecting controllers or connecting PS4 controllers. (Added and fixed 6/8/2017)
- False button guides displayed using Xbox360 controllers. (Added and fixed 6/8/2017)
- Mistranslation of the effect for "wing" type artifacts. (Added and fixed 6/8/2017)


Thanks! 
JUN_NISA
